SELECT input_table.employee_name, input_table.job_title, input_table.department, input_table.annual_salary, input_table.location, avg_salary_by_title.avg_salary
FROM input_table
INNER JOIN avg_salary_by_title ON input_table.job_title = avg_salary_by_title.job_title
ORDER BY avg_salary_by_title.avg_salary DESC;
